subject: objections to truecap, handled
preheader: i hear the same three things. here are honest answers.
headline: Three honest pushbacks on TrueCap, and what I'd say back.
body: "I already have a spreadsheet." A good spreadsheet is genuinely powerful. TrueCap is useful as a faster first pass with labeled assumptions; keep using your detailed model for the properties that survive the screen and reconcile any differences.

"I trust my gut." Experience matters for questions a model cannot answer, such as condition and local operations. Standardized cash-flow and DSCR calculations add a second check, but they are only as reliable as the inputs and lender-specific definitions you verify.

"Pro costs too much for my workflow." That may be true. Use Free if a first-pass screen is enough. Pro is intended for people who repeatedly need editing, scenarios, comparison, a target-dependent Offer Ceiling, strategy models, and reports; compare the current price with your own usage before upgrading.
Free tier is free forever, no card, no trial. Pro is month-to-month, cancel anytime. There's no lock-in to be skeptical about.
